Rahul Gandhi criticizes exam paper leaks, calls for education system reform

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has voiced concerns over recent examination paper leaks, stating that the education system needs to be rebuilt from scratch to address the issue and reduce student stress. He highlighted that such leaks disproportionately affect poor students and pointed to a lack of accountability, citing 152 leaks in the past decade with no convictions. Gandhi suggested the entire education system is involved in these leaks, urging for a revolution against corruption in education.
